latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — generates compliant UK landlord documentation templates for England, covering the latest legal requirements.

- Supports Section 8 notices with all 37 possession grounds under the Renters' Rights Act 2025.
- Provides templates for tenancy agreements, rent increase notices, prescribed deposit information, Right to Rent checks, and safety certification trackers.
- Includes a legislation reference index for key statutes and regulations.
- Offers up-to-date guidance on the abolition of Section 21 and changes effective from 1 May 2026.
- Every output includes a clear legal disclaimer and coverage area note (England only).
